summary_en: Chapter 94 opens with the scene header 'The first meeting:'.
summary_fa: فصل ۹۴ با سربرگ صحنهٔ «جلسهٔ اول» آغاز می‌شود.
verbatim_html: The first meeting:

summary_en: At 6:07am on April 17th, 1992 dawn light filters into the Ravenclaw first-year boys' dorm. Harry sleeps, exhausted, until a small man quietly enters, approaches his bed, touches his shoulder, and wakes him with a shriek that no one else hears.
summary_fa: در ساعت ۶:۰۷ صبح ۱۷ آوریل ۱۹۹۲، نور سپیده به خوابگاه پسران سال اول ریونکلاو می‌تابد. هری خسته خوابیده است تا مردی کوچک بی‌صدا وارد می‌شود، به تختش نزدیک می‌شود، شانه‌اش را لمس می‌کند و او را با فریادی بیدار می‌کند که هیچ‌کس دیگری نمی‌شنود.
verbatim_html:
At 6:07am on April 17th, 1992 the Sun was just rising above the
horizon as seen from the castle Hogwarts, filtering in through
drawn curtains in the Ravenclaw first-year boys' dorm to provide a
gentle light, red-orange for dawn and little-changed by the white
fabric covering the windows, not yet waking boys more accustomed to
winter's schedule.

In one bed among many, Harry Potter slept the sleep of the just
exhausted.
Quietly the door opened.
Quietly a figure walked across the floor.
That figure came to Harry Potter's bed.

The figure laid a hand on the shoulder of the sleeping boy, who
started and shrieked.
No others heard.

summary_en: The small man squeaks that the Headmaster has requested Harry immediately. Harry sits up, surprised he feels lucid rather than incapacitated by grief; his resolve to revive Hermione feels sufficient. He says he will get dressed.
summary_fa: مرد کوچک می‌گوید مدیر فوراً هری را خواسته است. هری می‌نشیند و شگفت‌زده است که به جای ناتوانی از غم، ذهنش روشن است؛ عزمش برای زنده کردن هرماینی کافی به نظر می‌رسد. می‌گوید لباس می‌پوشد.
verbatim_html:
"Mr. Potter," the small man squeaked, "the Headmaster has
requested your presence immediately."

Slowly the boy sat up in bed, his hands momentarily fiddling
beneath the covers. He'd expected to feel much worse, waking up
this morning. It felt... wrong, that his brain functioned now, that
his thoughts still moved, that he wasn't incapacitated with weeping
for at least a week. The boy knew that it wouldn't have been an
adaptive response, for brains to evolve to do that. His dark side,
certainly, would not do that. Even so, it still felt wrong to be
alive and lucid, this morning.

But his resolution to revive Hermione Granger felt - sufficient, like he was already doing the right thing, bent on the right path, and she would be brought back, and that was all there was to it; grief would have been giving up. There was nothing left to decide, no ambiguity, no conflict to tear at him, and no need to remember what he'd seen -
"I'll get dressed," Harry said.

summary_en: Professor Flitwick, reluctant, says Harry must go directly to the Headmaster's office. A minute later, via the internal Floo, Harry arrives in pajamas before Dumbledore, with McGonagall and Snape present.
summary_fa: استاد فلیتویک با اکراه می‌گوید هری باید مستقیم به دفتر مدیر برود. یک دقیقه بعد، از طریق فلوو داخلی، هری با پیژامه در برابر دامبلدور حاضر می‌شود و مک‌گوناگال و سناپ هم آنجا هستند.
verbatim_html:
Professor Flitwick looked rather reluctant, but said in his high
voice, "The Headmaster specified you were to be brought to his
office directly and without pause, Mr. Potter. I'm sorry."

Less than a minute later - Professor Flitwick had sent him
straight to the Headmaster's office through the Hogwarts internal
Floo - Harry found himself, still in his pajamas, facing Albus
Dumbledore. The Deputy Headmistress was also sitting in another
chair, and the Potions Master lurked nearby amid the weird devices,
caught in a gaping yawn just as Harry had entered through the
fireplace.

"Harry," the Headmaster said without preamble, "before I say
what I must say next, I tell you that Hermione Granger did truly
die. The wards recorded it and informed me. The very stones spoke
that a witch had died. I tested her body where it lay and those
were Hermione Granger's true mortal remains, not any doll or
likeness. There is no way known to wizardry by which death may be
undone. All this being said, Hermione Granger's remains are now
missing from the storeroom where they were placed, and where you
guarded them. Did you take them, Harry Potter?"

"No," Harry said, narrowing his eyes. A glance showed him that
Severus was watching him intently.

summary_en: Dumbledore tells Harry Hermione truly died; wards recorded it and the stones confirmed her remains, which are now missing from the storeroom where Harry guarded them. He asks if Harry took them.
summary_fa: دامبلدور به هری می‌گوید هرماینی واقعاً مرده است؛ حفاظ‌ها آن را ثبت کردند و سنگ‌ها بقایایش را تأیید کردند، اما بقایا اکنون از انباری که هری از آن‌ها محافظت می‌کرد گم شده‌اند. او می‌پرسد آیا هری آن‌ها را برداشته است.
verbatim_html:
Dumbledore's gaze was also keen, though not unfriendly. "Is
Hermione Granger's body in your possession?"
"No."
"Do you know where it is?"
"No."

summary_en: Dumbledore interrogates Harry: does he know where the body is, who took it, or why? Harry speculates the enemy wondered why he guarded the body, then asks if Dumbledore arranged Hermione's death to get money back from Lucius.
summary_fa: دامبلدور از هری بازجویی می‌کند: آیا می‌داند جسد کجاست، چه کسی آن را برده یا چرا؟ هری حدس می‌زند دشمن کنجکاو شده چرا او از جسد محافظت می‌کرد، سپس می‌پرسد آیا دامبلدور مرگ هرماینی را ترتیب داده تا پول را از لوسیوس پس بگیرد.
verbatim_html: "Do you know who took it?"

"No," Harry said, then hesitated. "Besides the obvious
probabilistic speculations which are not based upon any specific
knowledge of mine."
The old wizard nodded. "Do you know why it was taken?"
"No. Besides the obvious speculations etcetera."
"What would those be?" Sharp the ancient eyes.

"If the enemy can notice you running off to consult the Weasley
twins during class after Hermione was arrested, and find out about
that magic map you said was stolen, then the enemy can wonder why I
was guarding Hermione Granger's body. My turn. Did you arrange for
Hermione's death in hopes of getting the money back from
Lucius?"

summary_en: McGonagall exclaims 'What?' and Dumbledore denies arranging Hermione's death. He says he did not know or will her death, did not allow or plan to benefit from it, and demands to see Harry's pouch.
summary_fa: مک‌گوناگال می‌گوید «چی؟» و دامبلدور ترتیب دادن مرگ هرماینی را انکار می‌کند. می‌گوید نه مرگ او را می‌دانست و نه می‌خواست، و نه اجازه داد یا برنامه‌ای برای سود بردن از آن داشت، و می‌خواهد کیف هری را ببیند.
verbatim_html: "What? " said Professor McGonagall.
"No," said the old wizard.
"Did you know or suspect that Hermione Granger would die?"

"I did not know. As for suspicions, I placed her in the most
strongly defended position I could, against Voldemort. I did not
will her death, nor allow it, nor plan to benefit from it, Harry
Potter. Now show me your pouch."

summary_en: Harry says the pouch is in his trunk. Dumbledore orders Snape to check every compartment. Harry says his trunk is warded; Snape grins mirthlessly and strides into the green flame.
summary_fa: هری می‌گوید کیف در صندوقش است. دامبلدور به سناپ دستور می‌دهد هر محفظه را بررسی کند. هری می‌گوید صندوقش حفاظ دارد؛ سناپ بی‌شادی پوزخند می‌زند و به میان شعلهٔ سبز می‌رود.
verbatim_html: "It's in my trunk -" Harry began.

"Severus," said the old wizard, and the Potions Master moved
forward. "Check his trunk as well, every compartment."
"My trunk has wards."

Severus Snape grinned mirthlessly and strode into the green
flame.

summary_en: Dumbledore waves his wand around Harry's hair like a metal detector, then stops and notes the ring's gem is no longer a clear diamond but brown, the color of Hermione's eyes and hair.
summary_fa: دامبلدور چوب جادویش را مثل فلزیاب دور موهای هری می‌چرخاند، سپس می‌ایستد و می‌بیند نگین انگشتر دیگر الماس شفاف نیست بلکه قهوه‌ای است، رنگ چشم‌ها و موهای هرماینی.
verbatim_html:
Dumbledore took out his long dark-grey wand and began to wave it
close around Harry's hair, looking like a Muggle using a
metal-detector. Before he had reached as far as Harry's neck,
Dumbledore stopped.

"The gem upon your ring," Dumbledore said. "It is no longer a
clear diamond. It is brown, the color of Hermione Granger's eyes,
and the color of her hair."

summary_en: Tension fills the room. Harry says the ring gem is his father's rock, transfigured to remember Hermione. Dumbledore insists he take off the ring and place it on the desk; Harry slowly does so.
summary_fa: تنش اتاق را پر می‌کند. هری می‌گوید نگین انگشتر سنگ پدرش است که برای یادبود هرماینی تغییر شکل داده. دامبلدور اصرار می‌کند انگشتر را دربیاورد و روی میز بگذارد؛ هری آهسته این کار را می‌کند.
verbatim_html: A sudden tension filled the room.

"That's my father's rock," Harry said. "Transfigured the same as
before. I just did it to remember Hermione -"

"I must be sure. Take off that ring, Harry, and place it upon my
desk."

Slowly, Harry did so, removing the gem and setting the ring off
to the other side of the desk.

summary_en: Dumbledore points his wand at the gem and it suddenly expands into a large grey rock that hits an invisible barrier and cracks onto the desk. Harry says there's another half-hour of Transfiguration work to redo it.
summary_fa: دامبلدور چوبش را به سوی نگین می‌گیرد و ناگهان نگین به سنگی بزرگ و خاکستری گسترش می‌یابد که به سدی نامرئی برخورد می‌کند و روی میز ترک می‌خورد. هری می‌گوید نیم ساعت دیگر کار تغییر شکل برای بازسازی آن لازم است.
verbatim_html: Dumbledore pointed his wand at the gem and -

A large, undistinguished grey rock jumped into the air from the
force of its sudden expansion, hit some invisible barrier in the
air above, and then fell with a loud crack upon the Headmaster's
desk,

"There's another half-hour of work for me, Transfiguring it
again," Harry said evenly.

summary_en: Dumbledore resumes examining Harry: he must remove his shoe and the emergency portkey toe-ring, which is verified as a true portkey. Snape returns with Harry's pouch and other items from the trunk.
summary_fa: دامبلدور بررسی هری را از سر می‌گیرد: او باید کفشش و انگشتر پورتکی اضطراری روی انگشت پایش را دربیاورد، که تأیید می‌شود پورتکی واقعی است. سناپ با کیف هری و چیزهای دیگر از صندوق برمی‌گردد.
verbatim_html:
Dumbledore resumed his examination. Harry had to remove his left
shoe, and take off the toe-ring that was his emergency portkey if
someone kidnapped him and took him outside the wards of Hogwarts
(and didn't put up anti-Apparition, anti-portkey, anti-phoenix, and
anti-time-looping wards, which Severus had warned Harry that any
inner-circle Death Eater would certainly do). It was verified that
the magic radiating from the toe-ring was indeed the magic of a
portkey, and not the magic of a Transfiguration. The rest of Harry
was deemed clear.

Not long after, the Potions Master returned, bearing Harry's
pouch, and several other magical things which had been in Harry's
trunk, which the Headmaster also examined, one by one, even to all
the items remaining within the healer's kit.

summary_en: Harry asks if he can leave and starts feeding the grey rock into his pouch. Dumbledore apologizes, says the Dark Lord seems to have taken Hermione's remains possibly as an Inferius, and warns Harry to be prepared; Snape will give him potions.
summary_fa: هری می‌پرسد آیا می‌تواند برود و شروع می‌کند سنگ خاکستری را در کیفش بگذارد. دامبلدور عذرخواهی می‌کند، می‌گوید به نظر می‌رسد لرد تاریکی بقایای هرماینی را شاید به عنوان اینفریوس برده است و به هری هشدار می‌دهد آماده باشد؛ سناپ داروهایی به او می‌دهد.
verbatim_html:
"Can I go now?" Harry said when it was all done, putting as much
cold as he could into his voice. He took up his pouch, and began
the process of feeding the grey rock into it. The empty ring went
back on his finger.

The old wizard breathed out, slipping his wand back into his sleeve. "I am sorry," he said. "I had to know. Harry... the Dark Lord has taken Hermione Granger's remains, it seems. I cannot think of anything he would gain thereby, except to send her corpse against you as an Inferius. Severus shall give you certain potions to keep about your person. Be warned now, and be prepared for when you must do what must be done."

summary_en: Harry asks if the Inferius would have Hermione's mind; Dumbledore says no. Harry concludes it's not her and asks to leave to change out of his pyjamas.
summary_fa: هری می‌پرسد آیا اینفریوس ذهن هرماینی را خواهد داشت؛ دامبلدور می‌گوید نه. هری نتیجه می‌گیرد که آن او نیست و می‌خواهد برود و از پیژامه درآید.
verbatim_html: "Will the Inferius have Hermione's mind?"
"No -"

"Then it's not her. Can I go? At least to change out of my
pyjamas."

summary_en: Dumbledore says the wards record no foreign creature entered and that the Defense Professor killed Hermione. Harry says 'Um.'
summary_fa: دامبلدور می‌گوید حفاظ‌ها ثبت نکرده‌اند که موجود بیگانه‌ای وارد شده و استاد دفاع هرماینی را کشته است. هری می‌گوید «امم.»
verbatim_html:
"There is other news, but I shall be brief. The wards of
Hogwarts record that no foreign creature has entered, and that it
was the Defense Professor who killed Hermione Granger."
"Um," Harry said.

summary_en: Harry's thoughts race: he saw the troll kill Hermione; Quirrell Memory-Charmed him; Quirrell's magic can't touch his; can he trust his memories? Was there a debacle at Azkaban? Did he ever go to Azkaban? He practiced controlling Dementors; is he remembering the newspapers accurately?
summary_fa: افکار هری به سرعت می‌دوند: او دید ترول هرماینی را کشت؛ کوئیرل حافظه‌اش را جادو کرد؛ جادوی کوئیرل نمی‌تواند به او اثر کند؛ آیا می‌تواند به خاطراتش اعتماد کند؟ آیا در آزکابان فاجعه‌ای رخ داد؟ آیا هرگز به آزکابان رفت؟ او کنترل دیمنتورها را تمرین کرده بود؛ آیا روزنامه‌ها را درست به یاد می‌آورد؟
verbatim_html: Thought 1: But I saw the troll kill Hermione.
Thought 2: Professor Quirrell Memory-Charmed me and set up the scene that Dumbledore saw when he arrived.
Thought 3: Professor Quirrell can't do that, his magic can't touch mine. I saw that in Azkaban -
Thought 4: Can I trust those memories?
Thought 5: There was clearly some sort of debacle at Azkaban, we wouldn't have needed a rocket if Professor Quirrell hadn't fallen unconscious, and why'd he be unconscious if not -
Thought 6: Did I ever actually go to Azkaban at all?
Thought 7: I clearly practiced controlling Dementors at some point before I scared that Dementor in the Wizengamot. And that was in the newspapers.
Thought 8: Am I accurately remembering the newspapers?

summary_en: Harry says Memory-Charming ought to be Unforgiveable and asks if Quirrell could have done it. Dumbledore says no: he went back in time with instruments recording Hermione's last battle; Voldemort sabotaged her protections, the troll was a weapon, and the Defense Professor never crossed her path.
summary_fa: هری می‌گوید جادوی حافظه باید نفرین نابخشودنی باشد و می‌پرسد آیا کوئیرل می‌توانست این کار را بکند. دامبلدور می‌گوید نه: او با ابزارهایی که آخرین نبرد هرماینی را ثبت می‌کردند به گذشته رفت؛ ولدمورت محافظ‌های او را خراب کرد، ترول سلاحی بود و استاد دفاع هرگز از مسیر او نگذشت.
verbatim_html:
"Um," Harry said again. "That spell seriously ought to be
Unforgiveable. You think Professor Quirrell could have
Memory-Charmed -"

"No. I went back through time and placed certain instruments to
record Hermione's last battle, which I could not quite bear to
watch in my own person." The old wizard looked very grim indeed.
"Your guess was right, Harry Potter. Voldemort sabotaged everything
we gave Hermione to protect her. Her broomstick lay dead in her
hands. Her invisibility cloak did not conceal her. The troll walked
in the sunlight unharmed; it was no stray creature, but a weapon
pure and aimed. And it was indeed the troll who killed her, with
strength alone, so that my wards and webs to detect hostile magics
went for naught. The Defense Professor never crossed her path."

summary_en: Harry thinks this was an attempted frame on Quirrell, the enemy's modus operandi, but it can't be right. Snape says it seems obvious. Harry: that's the problem.
summary_fa: هری فکر می‌کند این تلاشی برای انداختن تقصیر به گردن کوئیرل بود، شیوهٔ همیشگی دشمن، اما نمی‌تواند درست باشد. سناپ می‌گوید واضح به نظر می‌رسد. هری: مشکل همین است.
verbatim_html: Harry swallowed, shut his eyes, and thought. "So this was an attempted frame on Professor Quirrell. Somehow. It does seem to be the enemy's modus operandi. Troll eats Hermione Granger, check the wards, oh look actually the Defense Professor did it, same as last year... no. No, that can't be right."

"Why not, Mr. Potter?" said the Potions Master. "It seems
obvious enough to me -"
"That's the problem."

summary_en: The enemy is smart. Slowly the fog of sleep leaves Harry's mind and, after a full night's sleep, his brain sees things that weren't obvious the day before.
summary_fa: دشمن باهوش است. آهسته مه خواب از ذهن هری می‌رود و پس از یک شب خواب کامل، مغزش چیزهایی را می‌بیند که روز قبل واضح نبودند.
verbatim_html: The enemy is smart.

Slowly the fog of sleep was drifting out of Harry's mind, and
after a full night's sleep his brain could see the things which
hadn't been obvious the day before.

summary_en: Under literary convention the enemy shouldn't sabotage your defenses and send an undetectable troll as a diabolus ex machina. But in real life the enemy thinks they're the main character and plans ahead; that's why everything feels disjointed.
summary_fa: طبق قراردادهای داستانی، دشمن نباید دفاع‌هایت را خراب کند و ترولی نامرئی را به عنوان «دیابولوس اکس ماخینا» بفرستد. اما در زندگی واقعی دشمن خود را شخصیت اصلی می‌داند و از پیش برنامه می‌ریزد؛ به همین دلیل همه چیز نامنسجم به نظر می‌رسد.
verbatim_html: Under standard literary convention... the enemy wasn't supposed to look over what you'd done, sabotage the magic items you'd handed out, and then send out a troll rendered undetectable by some means the heroes couldn't figure out even after the fact, so that you might as well have not defended yourself at all. In a book, the point-of-view usually stayed on the main characters. Having the enemy just bypass all the protagonists' work, as a result of planning and actions taken out of literary sight, would be a diabolus ex machina, and dramatically unsatisfying.

But in real life the enemy would think that they were the main
character, and they would also be clever, and think things through
in advance, even if you didn't see them do it. That was why
everything about this felt so disjointed, with parts unexplained
and seemingly inexplicable. How had Lucius felt, when Harry had
threatened Dumbledore with breaking Azkaban? How had the Aurors
above Azkaban felt, seeing the broomstick rise up on a torch of
fire?

summary_en: The enemy is smart. Harry realizes the enemy knew he'd turn back time and that fooling the wards is hard; they create a false appearance of omnipotence. He hypothesizes the wards could show Sinistra killing someone via Legilimency. Snape says unless that's what the Dark Lord expects; he does have control and Sinistra will be innocent. Does the Dark Lord use such meta plots? Yes, say Dumbledore and Severus.
summary_fa: دشمن باهوش است. هری می‌فهمد دشمن می‌دانست او زمان را برمی‌گرداند و فریب دادن حفاظ‌ها سخت است؛ آن‌ها ظاهری دروغین از قدرت مطلق می‌سازند. او فرض می‌کند حفاظ‌ها می‌توانند نشان دهند سینیسترا با لجیلمنسی کسی را می‌کشد. سناپ می‌گوید مگر اینکه لرد تاریکی همین را بخواهد؛ او کنترل دارد و سینیسترا بی‌گناه خواهد بود. آیا لرد تاریکی از چنین نقشه‌های فرا‌سطحی استفاده می‌کند؟ بله، دامبلدور و سوروس می‌گویند.
verbatim_html: The enemy is smart.

"The enemy knew perfectly well that you'd turn back time to check what really happened to Hermione, especially since the troll getting into Hogwarts at all tells us that somebody can fool the wards." Harry shut his eyes, thinking harder, trying to put himself into the enemy's shoes. Why would he, or his dark side, have done something like - "We're meant to conclude that the enemy has control of what the wards tell us. But that's actually something the enemy can only do with difficulty, or under special conditions; they're trying to create a false appearance of omnipotence." Like I would. "Later, hypothetically, the wards show Professor Sinistra killing someone. We think the wards are just being fooled again, but really, Professor Sinistra was Legilimized and she did do it."

"Unless that is precisely what the Dark Lord expects us to
think," said Severus Snape, his brow furrowed in concentration. "In
which case he does have control of the wards, and Professor
Sinistra will be innocent."
"Does the Dark Lord really use plots with that many levels of meta -"
"Yes," said Dumbledore and Severus.

summary_en: Harry thinks it's a setup to make them trust or distrust the wards, but they'd trust them anyway without reason to distrust, so framing Quirrell to trick them into meta reasoning is unnecessary. Dumbledore: if Voldemort hasn't fully mastered the wards, they had to believe a Professor's hand was at work, else they'd have cried out at Hermione's injury, not only her death.
summary_fa: هری فکر می‌کند این ترفندی است تا آن‌ها به حفاظ‌ها اعتماد کنند یا نکنند، اما آن‌ها بدون دلیلی برای بی‌اعتمادی به هر حال اعتماد می‌کردند، پس انداختن تقصیر به گردن کوئیرل برای فریب دادنشان به استدلال فرا‌سطحی لازم نیست. دامبلدور: اگر ولدمورت کاملاً بر حفاظ‌ها مسلط نشده، آن‌ها باید باور می‌کردند دست یک استاد در کار است، وگرنه از آسیب هرماینی فریاد می‌زدند، نه فقط از مرگش.
verbatim_html:
Harry nodded distantly. "Then this could be a setup to either
make us think the wards are telling the truth when they're lying,
or a setup to make us think the wards are lying when they're
telling the truth, depending on what level the enemy expects us to
reason at. But if the enemy is planning to make us trust the wards
- we would have trusted the wards anyway, if we'd been given no
reason to distrust them. So there's no need to go to all the work
of framing Professor Quirrell in a way that we would realize we
were intended to discover, just to trick us into going meta -"

"Not so," said Dumbledore. "If Voldemort has not fully mastered
the wards, then the wards had to believe that some Professor's hand
was at work. Else they would have cried out at Miss Granger's
injury, and not only upon her death."

summary_en: Harry rubs his brow and asks serious questions: why is he still alive? Is poisoning hard? Would wards trace the murderer? Could his scar contain a soul fragment keeping the Dark Lord anchored, driving off friends to weaken his spirit and take over his body? Dumbledore thought his blood was a ritual ingredient to restore Voldemort, requiring him to stay alive.
summary_fa: هری پیشانی‌اش را می‌مالد و سؤال‌های جدی می‌پرسد: چرا هنوز زنده است؟ آیا مسموم کردن سخت است؟ آیا حفاظ‌ها قاتل را ردیابی می‌کنند؟ آیا جای زخمش می‌تواند تکه‌ای روح داشته باشد که لرد تاریکی را نگه دارد، دوستان را دور کند تا روحش ضعیف شود و بدنش را تصاحب کند؟ دامبلدور فکر می‌کرد خون او مادهٔ یک آیین برای بازگرداندن ولدمورت است که زنده ماندنش را لازم می‌کند.
verbatim_html:
Harry reached up a hand and rubbed at his brow, just beneath his
hair.

Okay, serious question. If the enemy is that smart, why the heck am I still alive? Is it seriously that hard to poison someone, are there Charms and Potions and bezoars which can cure me of literally anything that could be slipped into my breakfast? Would the wards record it, trace the magic of the murderer?

Could my scar contain the fragment of soul that's keeping the Dark Lord anchored to the world, so he doesn't want to kill me? Instead he's trying to drive off all my friends to weaken my spirit so he can take over my body? It'd explain the Parselmouth thing. The Sorting Hat might not be able to detect a lich-phylactery-thingy. Obvious problem 1, the Dark Lord is supposed to have made his lich-phylactery-thingy in 1943 by killing whatshername and framing Mr. Hagrid. Obvious problem 2, there's no such thing as souls.

Though Dumbledore also thought that my blood was a key ingredient in a ritual to restore the Dark Lord's full strength, which would require keeping me alive until then... now there's a cheery thought.

summary_en: Harry says he's sure of one thing: Neville must be taken out of Hogwarts now; he's the obvious next target and no first-year can survive this offense. Dumbledore says if Harry sends his friends away himself, that's the same as Voldemort doing it.
summary_fa: هری می‌گوید یک چیز را مطمئن است: نویل باید همین حالا از هاگوارتز خارج شود؛ او هدف بعدی واضح است و هیچ دانش‌آموز سال اولی از این حمله جان سالم به در نمی‌برد. دامبلدور می‌گوید اگر هری خودش دوستانش را بفرستد، همان کاری است که ولدمورت می‌کرد.
verbatim_html: "Well..." Harry said. "I'm sure of one thing."
"And that is?"

"Neville needs to be taken out of Hogwarts now. He's the obvious next target and no first-year student can survive this level of offense. We're lucky Neville wasn't assassinated yesterday evening, the enemy doesn't have to wait until we're finished mourning to make their next move." Why didn't the enemy strike while we were distracted?

Dumbledore exchanged glances with Severus, and then with the
suddenly tight expression of Professor McGonagall. "Harry," said
the old wizard, "if you send all your friends away yourself, that
is just the same as if Voldemort -"

summary_en: Harry shouts he'll be fine without Neville and it's not sufficient justification to let him be killed. McGonagall agrees extremely. Harry asks if she'll haul Neville out herself regardless of orders. McGonagall wants responsibility without threats of unilateral action. Dumbledore: go, Minerva.
summary_fa: هری فریاد می‌زند بدون نویل خوب خواهد بود و این توجیه کافی نیست که بگذارد او کشته شود. مک‌گوناگال شدیداً موافق است. هری می‌پرسد آیا او خودش نویل را بیرون می‌برد حتی بدون دستور. مک‌گوناگال مسئولیت می‌خواهد بدون تهدید به اقدام یک‌جانبه. دامبلدور: برو، مینروا.
verbatim_html: "I will be fine I can do without Neville for a couple of extra months it's not like you were planning to make my friends stay here over the summer and that is just plain not sufficient justification to let him get killed! Professor McGonagall -"

"I quite agree," said the Scottish witch. She frowned. "I
extremely agree. I agree to the point where... I'm having some
trouble figuring out how to express this, Albus..."

"To the point where you're going to haul him out of there
yourself, regardless of what anyone else says, because it's no
excuse to say you were only following orders if Neville gets
killed?" Harry said.

Professor McGonagall closed her eyes briefly. "Yes, but surely
there ought to be some way to be responsible without threats of
unilateral action."

summary_en: Snape says they shouldn't call attention to Neville as Dumbledore did to the Weasley twins; it's wiser if his grandmother takes him from Hogwarts, staying in his Common Room since the Dark Lord can't act openly. After exchanged glances, Harry nods, followed by McGonagall.
summary_fa: سناپ می‌گوید نباید توجه را به نویل جلب کنند همان‌طور که دامبلدور به دوقلوهای ویزلی جلب کرد؛ عاقلانه‌تر است مادربزرگش او را از هاگوارتز ببرد و تا آن زمان در خوابگاهش بماند چون لرد تاریکی نمی‌تواند آشکارا عمل کند. پس از نگاه‌هایی که رد و بدل می‌شود، هری سر تکان می‌دهد و مک‌گوناگال هم همین کار را می‌کند.
verbatim_html: The Headmaster sighed. "No need. Go, Minerva."

"Wait," the Potions Master said, just as Professor McGonagall,
moving rather swiftly, was taking a pinch of green dust from the
Floo-vase. "We should not call attention to the boy, as the
Headmaster called attention to the Weasley twins. It would be
wiser, I think, if Mr. Longbottom's grandmother took him from
Hogwarts. Let him stay in his Common Room for now; the Dark Lord
does not seem able to act so openly."

There was another long exchange of glances among the four, and
finally Harry nodded, followed by Professor McGonagall.
"In that case," said Harry, "I'm sure of one other thing."

summary_en: Harry says he's sure of one other thing: he needs to visit the washroom and change out of his pyjamas.
summary_fa: هری می‌گوید یک چیز دیگر را مطمئن است: باید به دستشویی برود و از پیژامه درآید.
verbatim_html: "And that is?" said Dumbledore.

"I very much need to visit the washroom, and I would also like
to change out of these pyjamas."

summary_en: Harry asks if the sword the Weasley twins pulled from the Sorting Hat was the Sword of Gryffindor. Dumbledore says what makes Harry think that; Harry cites the Hat yelling Gryffindor, the ruby pommel, gold letters, and Latin 'Nothing better.' Dumbledore says 'Nihil supernum' doesn't quite mean that.
summary_fa: هری می‌پرسد آیا شمشیری که دوقلوهای ویزلی از کلاه گروه‌بندی بیرون کشیدند شمشیر گریفیندور بود. دامبلدور می‌پرسد چه چیزی این فکر را به سر هری انداخته؛ هری به فریاد کلاه «گریفیندور»، دستهٔ یاقوت‌نشان، حروف طلایی و عبارت لاتین «چیزی بهتر نیست» اشاره می‌کند. دامبلدور می‌گوید «نیهیل سوپرنوم» دقیقاً این معنی را نمی‌دهد.
verbatim_html:
"By the way," Harry said as he and the Headmaster emerged from
Floo into the empty office of the Ravenclaw Head of House. "One
last quick question I wanted to ask just you. That sword the
Weasley twins pulled out of the Sorting Hat. That was the Sword of
Gryffindor, wasn't it?"

The old wizard turned, face neutral. "What makes you think that,
Harry?"
"The Sorting Hat yelled Gryffindor! just before handing it out, the sword had a ruby pommel and gold letters on the blade, and the Latin script said Nothing better. Just a hunch."
"Nihil supernum," said the old wizard. "That is not quite what it means."

summary_en: Harry asks what Dumbledore did with it; Dumbledore retrieved it and placed it securely, hoping Harry isn't greedy. Harry asks if the Weasley twins are the Heir of Gryffindor. Dumbledore says Slytherin built a Chamber but Gryffindor wasn't extravagant; he left his Sword to defend Hogwarts against an unbeatable foe. Harry notes Dumbledore didn't say no.
summary_fa: هری می‌پرسد دامبلدور با آن چه کرد؛ دامبلدور آن را بازیافت و در جای امنی گذاشت و امیدوار است هری طمع‌کار نباشد. هری می‌پرسد آیا دوقلوهای ویزلی وارث گریفیندور هستند. دامبلدور می‌گوید اسلیترین اتاقی ساخت اما گریفیندور اهل تجمل نبود؛ او شمشیرش را گذاشت تا هاگوارتز را در برابر دشمنی شکست‌ناپذیر دفاع کند. هری اشاره می‌کند که دامبلدور «نه» نگفت.
verbatim_html: Harry nodded. "Mmhm. What'd you do with it?"

"I retrieved it from where it fell, and placed it in a secure
place," the old wizard said. He gave Harry a stern look. "I hope
you are not greedy for it yourself, young Ravenclaw."

"Not at all, just want to make sure you're not keeping it
permanently from its rightful wielders. So the Weasley twins are
the Heir of Gryffindor, then?"

"The Heir of Gryffindor?" Dumbledore said, looking surprised.
Then the old wizard smiled, blue eyes twinkling brightly. "Ah,
Harry, Salazar Slytherin may have built a Chamber of Secrets into
Hogwarts, but Godric Gryffindor was not much given to such
extravagances. We have seen only that Godric left his Sword to the
defense of Hogwarts, if a worthy student ever faced a foe they
could not defeat alone."

"That's not the same as saying no. Don't think I didn't notice
that you didn't actually say no."

"I did not live in those years, Harry, and I do not know all
that Godric Gryffindor may or may not have done -"

summary_en: Harry demands yes-or-no: does Dumbledore assign over fifty percent probability to a Heir of Gryffindor being one/both Weasley twins? Dumbledore sighs: yes, Fred and George are the Heir; don't tell them yet. Harry is surprised they aren't like Godric in history. Dumbledore: only a proud and vain man thinks his heir should be like himself rather than who he wished to be. The Headmaster steps into green fire and is gone.
summary_fa: هری پاسخ بله یا خیر می‌خواهد: آیا دامبلدور بیش از پنجاه درصد احتمال می‌دهد وارث گریفیندور یکی یا هر دوی دوقلوهای ویزلی باشد؟ دامبلدور آه می‌کشد: بله، فرد و جورج وارث هستند؛ فعلاً به آن‌ها نگو. هری شگفت‌زده است که آن‌ها مثل گودریک در تاریخ نیستند. دامبلدور: فقط مردی متکبر و خودپسند فکر می‌کند وارثش باید شبیه خودش باشد نه کسی که آرزو داشت باشد. مدیر به میان شعلهٔ سبز می‌رود و ناپدید می‌شود.
verbatim_html:
"Do you in fact assign greater than fifty percent subjective
probability that there is something like a Heir of Gryffindor and
one or both Weasley twins are it. Yes or no, evasion means yes.
You're not going to succeed in distracting me, no matter how much I
have to go to the bathroom."

The old wizard sighed. "Yes, Fred and George Weasley are the
Heir of Gryffindor. I beg you not to speak of it to them, not
yet."

Harry nodded, and turned to go. "I'm surprised," Harry said. "I
read a little about Godric Gryffindor's historical life. The
Weasley twins are... well, they're awesome in various ways, but
they don't seem much like the Godric in the history books."

"Only a man exceedingly proud and vain," Dumbledore said
quietly, as he turned back to the Floo roaring up again with green
flames, "would believe that his heir should be like himself, rather
than like who he wished that he could be."

summary_en: The second meeting: in a cubby off the Hufflepuff Common Room, Neville speaks to empty air (Harry under his cloak). Neville admits he betrayed Harry by conforming to authority. Harry says Neville wasn't blindly obeying but trying to protect him; soldiers who follow rules for friends are significantly better than worthless.
summary_fa: جلسهٔ دوم: در گوشه‌ای از اتاق مشترک هافلپاف، نویل با هوای خالی حرف می‌زند (هری زیر شنل). نویل اعتراف می‌کند که با اطاعت از قدرت به هری خیانت کرد. هری می‌گوید نویل کورکورانه اطاعت نمی‌کرد بلکه می‌خواست از او محافظت کند؛ سربازانی که برای دوستان از قوانین پیروی می‌کنند بسیار بهتر از بی‌ارزش‌ها هستند.
verbatim_html: The Headmaster stepped into green fire, and was gone.
The second meeting (in a small cubby off the Hufflepuff Common Room):

Neville Longbottom's face was drawn up in anguish, as he spoke
with no one to hear, to the empty air.

"Seriously," the empty air said back to him. "I'm wearing an invisibility cloak with extra anti-detection charms just to walk through the hallways because I don't want to be killed. My parents would have me out of Hogwarts in an instant if the Headmaster allowed it. Neville, your getting the heck out of Hogwarts is common sense, it has nothing to do with -"

"I betrayed you, General," Neville said, his voice around as
hollow as any normal eleven-year-old boy could reasonably manage.
"I didn't even do it the Chaotic way. I conformed to authority and
tried to make you conform to authority too. What's that you always
say, about how in the Chaos Legion, a soldier who can only obey
orders is useless?"

"Neville," the empty air said firmly. The pressure of two hands,
beneath thin cloth, came firmly to bear on Neville's shoulders; and
the voice moved closer to him. "You weren't blindly obeying
authority, you were trying to protect me. It's true that in this
chaotic world, soldiers who can only follow rules and regulations
are worthless. However, soldiers who follow rules for the sake of
protecting their friends are -"

summary_en: Harry says Neville's error cost six seconds; even in the counterfactual where Neville didn't step in front, Hermione still died. Neville says Harry ran after her and it's his fault. The empty air goes silent, then explains egocentric bias: nobody else blames Neville; he's being a silly-dilly and should say goodbye.
summary_fa: هری می‌گوید اشتباه نویل شش ثانیه هزینه داشت؛ حتی در فرض خلاف واقع که نویل جلو نمی‌آمد، هرماینی باز هم می‌مرد. نویل می‌گوید هری به دنبالش دوید و تقصیر اوست. هوای خالی ساکت می‌شود، سپس سوگیری خودمحوری را توضیح می‌دهد: هیچ‌کس دیگری نویل را سرزنش نمی‌کند؛ او دارد احمق‌بازی درمی‌آورد و باید خداحافظی کند.
verbatim_html: "Slightly better than worthless?" Neville said bitterly.

"Significantly better than worthless. Neville, you made an error of judgment. It cost me around six seconds. Now it could be that Hermione's injuries were just barely fatal, but even then, I don't think six seconds was actually enough time for the troll to take an extra bite of Hermione. In the counterfactual world where you didn't step in front of me, Hermione still died. Now, I could stand here listing out the first dozen ways that Hermione would be alive if I hadn't been stupid -"
"You? You ran right out after her. I'm the one who tried to stop you. It's my fault if it's anyone's," Neville said bitterly.
The empty air went silent at this for a while.

"Wow," the empty air finally said. "Wow. That puts a pretty different perspective on things, I have to say. I'm going to remember this the next time I feel an impulse to blame myself for something. Neville, the term in the literature for this is 'egocentric bias', it means that you experience everything about your own life but you don't get to experience everything else that happens in the world. There was way, way more going on than you running in front of me. You're going to spend weeks remembering that thing you did there for six seconds, I can tell, but nobody else is going to bother thinking about it. Other people spend a lot less time thinking about your past mistakes than you do, just because you're not the center of their worlds. I guarantee to you that nobody except you has even considered blaming Neville Longbottom for what happened to Hermione. Not for a fraction of a second. You are being, if you will pardon the phrase, a silly-dilly. Now shut up and say goodbye."

summary_en: Neville says he doesn't want to say goodbye; he wants to stay and fight. The empty air embraces him in a hug and Harry whispers 'Tough luck.'
summary_fa: نویل می‌گوید نمی‌خواهد خداحافظی کند؛ می‌خواهد بماند و بجنگد. هوای خالی او را در آغوش می‌گیرد و هری زمزمه می‌کند «بدشانسی.»
verbatim_html:
"I don't want to say goodbye," Neville said. His voice was
trembling, but he managed not to cry. "I want to stay here and
fight with you against - against whatever's happening."

The empty air moved closer to him, and embraced him in a hug,
and Harry Potter's voice whispered, "Tough luck."
